about_short_description.short_description: Arpari is a commercial real estate financial management platform.

product.name: Arpari Treasury Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes bank data, automates cash reporting, and manages payments across multiple banks in real time.

product.name: Multibank Payments
product.description: A payment processing service that enables users to initiate and approve payments across multiple bank accounts from a single dashboard with uniform approval workflows.

identifier.value: Bank Connectivity via API and Secure File Transfer

product.name: Bank Connectivity via API and Secure File Transfer
product.description: A connectivity service that integrates bank data into the platform using real-time APIs or secure file transfers to cover all US banks.

identifier.value: Automated Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable (AP/AR)

product.name: Automated Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable (AP/AR)
product.description: A feature that automates invoice issuance, payment, and reconciliation with bank transactions to reduce manual effort in AP and AR processes.

product.name: Custom Reporting and Transaction Tagging
product.description: Tools to create tailored cash reports and enhance transaction data with customizable tags for improved cash flow analysis and general ledger coding.
